p1.title: Shipping realtime collaboration at scale
p1.excerpt: How we rebuilt our sync engine to support millions of concurrent edits without breaking a sweat.
p1.body:
Realtime collaboration sounds simple until you have thousands of users editing the same document. In this post we walk through the architecture behind our new sync engine, the trade-offs we made with CRDTs, and how we kept latency under 50ms worldwide.

We started by mapping every conflict scenario, then designed a merge strategy that favors user intent over raw timestamps. The result is an experience that feels instant, even on flaky connections.

p2.title: A practical guide to workflow automation
p2.excerpt: Five automations every team should set up in their first week to save hours of manual work.
p2.body:
Automation is the fastest way to reclaim your team's time. We break down five high-impact automations — from auto-assigning tasks to syncing data across tools — and show you exactly how to build them with GloryPhone's visual rule builder.

Each example includes the trigger, the conditions, and the action, so you can copy them directly into your workspace.

p3.title: Designing for dark mode the right way
p3.excerpt: Dark mode is more than inverting colors. Here is how we approach contrast, depth, and accent theming.
p3.body: A great dark mode respects contrast ratios, preserves hierarchy, and never feels like a flat inversion of the light theme. We share the token system we use, why we layer surfaces instead of using pure black, and how swappable accent colors stay accessible in both themes.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the product and billing.

q1.q: Can I try GloryPhone for free?
q1.a: Yes. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial — no credit card required. You can explore every feature and invite your team during the trial.

q2.q: Can I change or cancel my plan anytime?
q2.a: Absolutely. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time from your billing settings. Changes take effect immediately and we prorate the difference.

q3.a: Security is foundational. We are SOC 2 Type II compliant, encrypt data at rest and in transit, and offer SSO and granular role-based permissions on higher plans.

q4.q: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits or education?
q4.a: Yes, we offer up to 50% off for qualifying nonprofits, students, and educators. Reach out to our team and we'll get you set up.

q5.a: We support 100+ integrations including Slack, GitHub, Google Workspace, Notion, and most major data warehouses. We also offer a full REST API and webhooks.
